64 x 48 display · courtyard, mountains, spiral platform and toy shop niche

Nightmare Before Christmas display

The full display: baseplates and bridging plates, the snow strip and road, the sideways-masonry courtyard, then the mountains layer by layer, peak by peak, with the toy shop niche span and the spiral platform. 4,455 pieces to build, plus one tan 6 x 6 plate that only marks where the 21351 spiral sits (it is not a part to buy).

Red boxWhere this sub-step's pieces go. New pieces are in full colour; everything built earlier is pale blue-grey.
CoordinatesSeen from the front: col counts studs from the left edge, row counts from the front edge. A range like col 5-8 is the piece's full length.
Tick listsTap a row when the piece is on. The next piece to place glows yellow in the picture. Ticks are saved in this browser.
3D and step by stepTap 3D on any picture to turn the model with your finger. Step by step shows one sub-step at a time; swipe the picture to move on.
PartsTap the Parts tab on the right, or swipe in from the right edge, to see the pieces for the step you are on.
Build in 3DFills the screen with the 3D model. The next piece glows yellow: put it on and tap Placed. Swipe in from the left edge for the tick list.
